messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled config-only deploy (canary) for routing/timeout/batching tweaks. Canary set to 10% for 30m window. Changes: default_route_weight=0.1 -> 0.08, token_timeout_ms=1200 -> 1000, batch_window_ms=6 -> 4. See runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/config-canary

maya: quick q — are we also bumping the per-tenant qps cap? I only see route and timeout changes.

ethan: Right, not touching tenant_qps. This is purely route-weight/timeouts/batching to reduce tail latency.

ethan: Pasted the exact patch below:
```
service.routing.default_weight = 0.08
service.timeouts.token_ms = 1000
serving.batching.window_ms = 4
serving.batching.max_batch_tokens = 2048
```

maya: thanks. Can we include a soft-fallback to previous config if error_rate > 1% or p95 latency regresses by > 200ms?

liam: Added the gating rule in canary config: 
`canary.fail_conditions = ["error_rate>1.0","p95_latency_delta>200"]`

deploy-bot: Canary started (1719674321). Target traffic: 10% across prod regions (us-east1, eu-west1). Monitoring: /dashboards/canary/1719674321. Will post updates every 5m or on state change.

oncall-ops: I'll watch logs for KV cache pressure — previous small batches increased KV pressure in us-east during a similar change. If we see increased cache misses we should roll back.

ethan: Good call. Observability hooks in place (kv_cache_miss_rate, servicer_errors). Alerts: canary-alerting-policy-1719 is active.

sophia: FYI traffic-shaping note: routing change reduces capacity headroom on old route. We might see slight queueing for heavy seq-length requests. I'd prefer we hold at 10% for full 30m before increasing.

maya: agreed. Hold for 30m, if stable we'll step to 30% then 100% over next 2h.

deploy-bot: Canary update (1719674381): 5m in. Metrics: error_rate=0.12% (baseline 0.10%), p95_delta=+30ms, kv_cache_miss_rate +0.8%. No fail conditions hit.

liam: small blip in one pod, but traffic rerouted immediately — looks transient.

deploy-bot: Canary update (1719674412): 30m complete. Summary: error_rate=0.09% (below threshold), p95_delta=+45ms, kv_cache_miss_rate +1.3% (slightly above expected but not triggering fail-policy). Decision: Proceed to 30% ramp per plan.

maya: rolling to 30% now. Please keep alerts loud for next 30m. :loud_sound:

oncall-ops: I enabled a short-term KV cache autoscale policy for us-east just in case. Will rollback manually if miss rate climbs above 2.5%.

sophia: documenting change in release notes section: "Config-only: route weight decrease, lower token timeout to 1000ms, tighter batching window (4ms) to reduce tail latency. Observed slight kv cache increase; monitoring."

e than: leaving a small follow-up task: perf-test synthetic with long-seq profile to validate no regression in throughput. Ticket: https://issues.redwood/INC-2481

deploy-bot: Rollout step scheduled: 30% start (1719674521). If no regressions, target 100% at 2h mark. React with :thumbsup: to acknowledge or post concerns.

maya: :thumbsup:

liam: :thumbsup:

sophia: :thumbsup:

oncall-ops: Monitoring — standing by.
